Coventry City Council
Revenues and Benefits
158 Evans Court
Truro TR1 5TR
Web: www.gov.uk

Council Tax: you have moved 

Mr L. O'Connor
The Maltings
163 Sandringham Terrace
COVENTRY, CV1 2UG

Date of issue 18 Aug 2026
Council Tax account number 80982970

Dear Mr O'Connor,

We have updated our records to show that you left The Maltings, 163 Sandringham Terrace, Coventry CV1 2UG on 21 Jul 2026. We have ended your liability at your previous address.

A final bill of £198.89 for your old address is enclosed. A new bill for your new address, account 34790138, will follow.

If you think your band is wrong you can ask the Valuation Office Agency to review it.

We are required by law to protect the public funds we administer and may share information with other bodies to prevent and detect fraud. Giving false information to obtain a discount is a criminal offence.

You can manage your account, sign up for e-billing and report a change online. Our phone lines are open Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm.

You must tell us within 21 days about any change that could affect your bill. Tell us straight away if anyone moves in or out of the property.

If you pay by bank transfer, use your account reference as the payment reference so we can match your payment.

If you need this information in another format, please let us know.

Thank you,
Head of Revenues
